import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int n = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        int m = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
        String[] aStr = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int[] a = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = Integer.parseInt(aStr[i]);
        }

        int mid = n / 2;
        List<Integer> firstPart = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> secondPart = new ArrayList<>();

        generateFirst(0, 0, a, m, mid, firstPart);
        generateSecond(mid, 0, a, m, n, secondPart);

        Set<Integer> firstSet = new HashSet<>(firstPart);
        List<Integer> firstUnique = new ArrayList<>(firstSet);
        Collections.sort(firstUnique);

        int best = 0;
        for (int val : secondPart) {
            int target = m - val;
            int idx = Collections.binarySearch(firstUnique, target);
            if (idx < 0) {
                idx = -idx - 1;
            }
            if (idx > 0) {
                int candidate = firstUnique.get(idx - 1) + val;
                if (candidate > best) {
                    best = candidate;
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(best);
    }

    private static void generateFirst(int i, int total, int[] a, int m, int mid, List<Integer> firstPart) {
        if (i == mid) {
            firstPart.add(total);
        } else {
            generateFirst(i + 1, (total + a[i]) % m, a, m, mid, firstPart);
            generateFirst(i + 1, total, a, m, mid, firstPart);
        }
    }

    private static void generateSecond(int i, int total, int[] a, int m, int n, List<Integer> secondPart) {
        if (i == n) {
            secondPart.add(total);
        } else {
            generateSecond(i + 1, (total + a[i]) % m, a, m, n, secondPart);
            generateSecond(i + 1, total, a, m, n, secondPart);
        }
    }
}
